'''2000 Utah State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Utah in April 2000. It is known from Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d667">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 4 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2000
* '''Site:''' Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
